line: Okay, I need to vent. I finally found a foundation that actually matches my redness, and I am sending it back. Here is why.

line: Every makeup counter told me nothing would ever match my redness. So why am I returning the one stick that finally did?

concepts.frame1: over the saleswoman's shoulder at the makeup counter: a bottle held to her red jaw, three wrong swatches, a slow head shake
concepts.stakes: the experts gave up on her skin
concepts.turn: cut to her at home holding the stick: 'So why am I returning…'

concepts.frame1: macro: the white balm laid across her red cheek, the brush turning it to her exact shade
concepts.stakes: proof it did what the counter said was impossible
concepts.turn: her face, puzzled at her own question

concepts.frame1: a row of wrong-shade bottles on the counter, each one too pink or too orange against her jaw
concepts.turn: the stick against her jaw — perfect
